title: apricity-cli: apricity export --kit with --help, -o, --library, --force and located errors
description:
## Intent

The command a person runs.

## Scope

- `crates/apricity-cli/src/export.rs` and a `Cmd::Export` in `crates/apricity-cli/src/main.rs` (shared with the set export's `--daw-set` and M3's `--clips`: one subcommand, one mode flag each, mutually exclusive, clap `ArgGroup`).
- `apricity export --kit <name> <score> [-o <file>] [--library <dir>] [--force]`; default output `<kit>.adg` in the current folder.
- `--help`: one line per flag and an example, in the voice of the other commands.
- Errors, all printed before exiting non-zero, nothing written on error: score problems as the compiler prints them (`file:line:col`); unknown kit with "did you mean"; a clip named instead of a kit; too many pads; missing audio; output exists without `--force`; unwritable output folder. Warnings (for example a pad whose sample has no beat grid) printed but not fatal.
- On success, one line: `wrote b.adg (8 pads)`.

## Verification

```sh
CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-cli --test export_cli
CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw --test daw_conformance
```
All M1 scenarios green. `apricity export --help` output pasted in a comment.

## Release

`feat(<this task id>): apricity export --kit`. Not breaking.

## Dependencies

Blocked by the warp task. If the set export has already added `Cmd::Export`, add the `--kit` mode to it.
